title: doronicum pyrenaicum
intro: Doronicum pyrenaicum, commonly known as Pyrenean leopard's bane, is a flowering plant species in the dandelion family (Asteraceae). This plant is known for its medicinal properties, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and alleviate symptoms of anxiety and stress. The health benefits of Doronicum pyrenaicum are attributed to its therapeutic actions, which include anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and sedative properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, such as doronic acid, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
